title: VisualTrust: Video Reasoning under On-Screen Claim Framing
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实
missingSignals: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce VisualTrust, a counterfactual benchmark with 5,063 cases across 14 claim-fact classes.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each case pairs a question with three versions of the same video: one with no claim, one with an accurate claim, and one with a misleading claim that alters a single grounded fact.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across seven open-weight and four proprietary models, mean accuracy falls from 90.1% without a claim to 51.9% with a misleading claim.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On 500 videos across three proprietary models, DEAR raises accuracy under misleading claims from 47.2--64.0% to 81.8--85.2% and reduces trap-answer selection from 34.4--50.8% to 11.6--15.0%, while preserving no-claim accuracy.
